title: Ash & Pikachu: The Journey
vo: In 1997, a boy from Pallet Town overslept on the most important day of his life.
The only Pokémon left at the lab was a Pikachu that refused its Poké Ball, and shocked its new trainer.
Then a flock of Spearow attacked. Ash shielded Pikachu with his own body, and Pikachu fought back.
As the storm cleared, a legendary rainbow bird flew overhead. A partnership was born.
For twenty-five years they crossed region after region, losing league after league, until Alola, where Ash finally won.
Then in 2022, Pikachu's thunderbolt toppled Champion Leon's Charizard, and Ash became World Champion.
But here's the twist: Ash decided he still wasn't a Pokémon Master. A true master must be friends with every Pokémon.
In 2023, new heroes took over the anime. But Ash and Pikachu's road never ends.
